capabilities: Opens .diff and .patch files in a custom read-only view
Shows file list and per-file stats
Falls back to raw text when no unified diff hunk is detected
disambiguation: Not a patch applier or Git client; it only renders diff and patch files in a read-only view.
extras: Scope statement: does not apply patches, call git, modify files, or bundle Git Viewer behavior.
problem: Obsidian shows .diff and .patch files as plain text with no structure, per-file stats, or change highlighting.
summary: Read-only viewer that renders .diff and .patch files with file lists, hunk headers, and addition/deletion highlighting.
